newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stable, interest thin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stable, interest thin.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber prices were stable in late trading on Wednesday, with buying interest remaining thin despite gains in Tokyo.
"The market was very slow today, with not many enquiries," one trader said. "The increases in Tokyo futures did not draw any buyers into our market."
The traders said Malaysia's SMR20 remained at a discount to SIR20, and was keeping the pressure on the local market.

They said that September shipment SIR20 was done at 43.25 cents/lb fob Padang late on Tuesday, and was on offer at 43.50-44.00 cents fob Medan, while October shipments were quoted at 44.25 cents. September SIR20 was quoted at 43.50 cents fob Palembang and Padang, and 43.75 cents fob Surabaya.
